assets.caption: FIGURE 12 THE ONSET-OF-CHOKING FOR A 36" OD BOTTLE AS A FUNCTION OF THE BOTTLE SLOPE
assets.notes: Line chart showing liquid intake rate (m3/s) vs bottle slope (%) for two conditions: Den Helder slug catcher (70 bar, solid line) and St Fergus slug catcher (110 bar, dashed line). Vertical markers at ~0.5% (St Fergus slug catcher onset-of-choking) and ~1.7% (Den Helder slug catcher onset-of-choking).
